About Us

Play. Learn. Level Up. 🎯

GyanIQ is a free online educational quiz and gaming platform, built for students and competitive-exam aspirants. Our mission is simple — turn learning from something boring into something engaging and fun.

What we offer

  • Current Affairs & GK Quiz — test your knowledge with regularly updated questions
  • NEET Warrior — MCQ practice and exam-style test papers covering Biology, Physics and Chemistry
  • Math & Science Games — fast-paced learning games like MathRush and Science Warrior
  • Fun Zone — classic games like Ludo, UNO, Snake and Chess for when you need a break
  • Live Leaderboard — track your rank and compete with other players

Our mission

Many students don't have easy access to quality educational resources, especially in a format that feels approachable. GyanIQ aims to close that gap — completely free, with no paywalls, so every student — whether preparing for a competitive exam or simply sharpening their general knowledge — can learn something new here.

Why GyanIQ?

  • 100% free — no hidden charges
  • Simple, approachable content
  • Game-based learning — practice that doesn't feel like a chore
  • Live leaderboard and rewards that keep you motivated
